title: SkyPulse PRO Weather PWA
description: SkyPulse PRO is a high-performance, real-time Progressive Web App (PWA) delivering hyper-accurate weather forecasts, interactive radar metrics, dynamic frosted glassmorphism themes, and AI-driven weather summaries.
problem: Standard weather applications are often cluttered with ads, slow to load, and lack offline capabilities or real-time location precision. SkyPulse PRO solves this by delivering an edge-to-edge mobile PWA experience with zero ads, real-time geolocation tracking, instant 24-hour hourly forecasts, and an integrated AI assistant.
features: Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline support & native mobile installation
Real-time Geolocation Weather Tracking & City Search
Dynamic Frosted Glassmorphism Theme (Adaptive Light & Dark Modes)
Integrated AI Assistant for personalized daily weather insights
Dynamic Interactive Weather Charts & Air Quality Index (AQI) Metrics
result: Achieved a 98+ Lighthouse performance rating, sub-second page loads, and a seamless PWA installation experience across iOS and Android devices.
